<style>
#generator-container {
  background-color: #ddd;
  width: 500px;
  height: 450px;
  border-radius: 30px;
  margin: 40px auto;
  padding: 30px;
  text-align: center;
  font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 20px;
}

#generator-title {
  font-size: 28px;
  font-weight: bold;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

#controls {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 20px;
}

#amount-label {
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: bold;
}

#amount-input {
  width: 60px;
  height: 35px;
  font-size: 16px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  text-align: center;
  border: 2px solid #aaa;
}

#generate-btn {
  padding: 10px 25px;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: bold;
  border-radius: 25px;
  background-color: #aaa;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}

#generate-btn:hover {
  background-color: #888;
}

#item-output {
  flex: 1;
  background-color: #eee;
  border-radius: 15px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 20px;
  text-align: center;
}
#copy-btn {
  padding: 10px 25px;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: bold;
  border-radius: 25px;
  background-color: #aaa;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  margin-top: 10px;
}

#copy-btn:hover {
  background-color: #888;
}
</style>

<div id="generator-container">
<div id="generator-title">Random Item Generator</div>
<div id="controls">
<div id="amount-label">Amount</div>
<input type="number" id="amount-input" min="1" value="1" />
<button id="generate-btn">Generate</button></div>
<div id="item-output"></div>
<button id="copy-btn">Copy</button>
</div>

  function removeDuplicates(arr) {
    const seen = new Set();
    return arr.filter(item => {
      const t = item.trim();
      if (seen.has(t)) return false;
      seen.add(t);
      return true;
    });
  }

  document.getElementById('generate-btn').addEventListener('click', function () {
    const amount = parseInt(document.getElementById('amount-input').value) || 1;
    const output = document.getElementById('item-output');
    output.innerHTML = '';

    // ✅ Use only unique items
    const uniqueItems = removeDuplicates(items);
    const shuffled = [...uniqueItems].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());
    const selected = shuffled.slice(0, amount);

    selected.forEach(item => {
      const div = document.createElement('div');
      div.textContent = item;
      output.appendChild(div);
    });
  });

  document.getElementById('copy-btn').addEventListener('click', function () {
    const output = document.getElementById('item-output');
    const text = Array.from(output.children).map(el => el.textContent).join('\n');
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
      alert('Items copied to clipboard!');
    });
  });
});
</script>
